Post the strangest call you ran this week, no names
Ask who's still awake after the last night shift
Suggest we grab tacos before everyone crashes.

situation: Three paramedics on the same crew, off shift.
topic: Unwinding after a rough run of night shifts with dark humour about the jobs they have been to.

text: Ok so 3 nights of 2300s and I have now seen a man try to pay a parking ticket with a head of cabbage and a guy asleep on a porch with the door open at -4. Dont ask
Anyway tacos tonight? Before everyone crashes 🌮
The cabbage one needs to be written down somewhere
Im in. Porch guy ok?
He was fine!! Very cold and very apologetic lol
What time
Can do 6. Ill be the one who smells like sleep
6 works. Have a lecture at 9 tmrw so ill bail early 🙃
Bail early is fine
On the way. The one on commercial or the other one
Commercial
Got home. The taco was good, the cabbage story is still with me 😂
The cabbage story is going to be the crew's story for a year
Home. Sleeping now
Up. Still smell like sleep
You smell fine. Bit of cabbage in the air tho
Lecture at 9 then library til 3. Whose turn is the coffee fund? I think it's mine
Priya's I think. She did last month
Did I?? I thought it was you Angela
I did october
Ok fine I'll do it. Jamal e-transfer me the number?
Its 40. Dont worry I got it this time 🙃
Sure you did
Can you take my sat 2300? Got a thing with my sister
Depends what I'm on sunday. Checking
Ok I can do it. Owe you one
You owe me like four
Anyone on tonight? Trying to figure out if the station will have coffee made or if I need to bring my own
On at 2300. Make your own, the machine's been doing the thing again
Ok bringing a thermos
Report's at 2300 and somehow I'm already tired. Send help or cabbage
Off. Home. Zero brain cells left
Morning. How was the night
Quiet after 0200. Had a guy who wanted a ride to his ex's so he could "just look at the house." Didn't go
Did you drive him anyway
No. Dropped him at the shelter on Main. He was ok about it
Lecture done. Brain soup. Anyone know if the ECG exam is the 11th or 12th
12th I think. Check the syllabus, I'm not your memory
😂 ok
My sister's kid threw up on me at 6am. Still at her place. Do not ask
Lol you have to say more now
Sick kid, my good jacket, two buses. I'm ok
Sorry Ang. Hope he's ok
He's fine, eating toast. He's a champ
Anyone want to split a pizza or should I eat the cold tacos from my fridge
Eat the tacos. Sleeping till 6 then coffee
Home. Showered twice. Still feel a bit like a bus seat
Lol. Coffee fund is paid btw, Jamal you can stop asking
I wasn't asking
Thermos is full. Tomorrow's problem is 9am
Good luck with the ECG thing
